policy_standard: BHOOMI Vision Dataset Legal Compliance & IP Governance

APPROVED_FOR_TRAINING.permission_summary: Unrestricted commercial/derivative model training permitted with standard academic attribution.
Non-commercial educational and research derivative model training permitted.
Permissive open-source academic/commercial reuse and model training permitted.
Open public community computer vision dataset; model training permitted.

TRAINING_USE_RESTRICTED.license: Government Open Data / Fair Use Research
TRAINING_USE_RESTRICTED.permission_summary: Internal prototype evaluation permitted; commercial/public API deployment requires formal ICAR data sharing agreement.

TRAINING_USE_BLOCKED.permission_summary: BLOCKED from training datasets. Preserved strictly as internal diagnostic references.

LICENSE_UNKNOWN.description: Any scraped internet images, unverified blog photos, or watermarked commercial stock photos without verifiable creative commons licensing.

training_eligibility_rule: Only assets belonging to APPROVED_FOR_TRAINING with mapping_confidence IN ('EXACT', 'STRONG') may be copied to canonical/ or assigned to training splits.
